scope: Twelve newly authored synthetic projects, not customers or external human trials. Freeze source and references before model execution; do not tune prompts on these results and then reuse them as unseen evidence.
referenceMethod: Author-proposed source labels require a separate source audit before freeze. Reference labels and rationales never enter provider input.
